metric: Equivalent query pairs proved (SQLSolver's authors say all are equivalent; the rest are left unknown, never called different). Every proof is re-checked on 120 random DuckDB databases, half skewed towards the literals; 7 proofs are unchecked because DuckDB rejects their queries.
caveats: Rules were developed against these pairs (tuned on test). The outer-join flattening rules (src/kumosql/outer_join_flatten.py) were written with this suite's failing pairs in view (tuned on test). Measured on master 9ba22c8, the merge of the outer-join flattening rules (#375). String functions over literals and selects over unions of constant rows are folded (src/kumosql/literal_fold_rules.py); that proves pair 53 and was developed on its shape and general cases, with the pair read (tuned on test). Measured on master 5bfbdee plus this change. S019 (Sol's final hand-back, measured on master d84972f): 224 to 229 proved, no proof lost (compared case by case). Counted membership (pairs 25 and 28), key-fixed singleton aggregation (142), projected IN (206) and mixed root-set identity (231) were developed with those pairs in view (tuned on test). Pairs 25, 28 and 142 report explicit grouped-key equality or collation conditions that callers must verify in their schemas. Pair 96 stays tie-sensitive, 100 keeps the unordered-LIMIT refusal and 115 has a legal numeric cancellation witness; all three remain unknown.
correctness: 0 false proofs (re-checked on 120 random DuckDB databases, half skewed towards the literals)
